items.exampleEn: He is clumsy with his hands but great at math.
items.exampleZh: 他手很笨，但數學很厲害。

items.exampleEn: It was folly to buy a white carpet with three dogs in the house.
items.exampleZh: 家裡養了三隻狗還買白色地毯，真是愚蠢。

items.exampleEn: The food at the hotel was dreadful.
items.exampleZh: 那家飯店的食物糟透了。

items.exampleEn: To everyone's amazement, the shy boy won the singing contest.
items.exampleZh: 讓大家驚訝的是，那個害羞的男孩贏得了歌唱比賽。

items.exampleEn: Don't humiliate your friends by sharing their silly photos online.
items.exampleZh: 別把朋友的蠢照片放到網路上，讓他們丟臉。

items.exampleEn: Her vanity made her check the mirror every few minutes.
items.exampleZh: 她的虛榮心讓她每隔幾分鐘就照一次鏡子。

items.exampleEn: She cleaned the whole house with great vigor.
items.exampleZh: 她精力充沛地打掃了整間房子。

items.exampleEn: He typed furiously to finish the report before noon.
items.exampleZh: 他拚命地打字，想在中午前完成報告。

items.sentenceEn: The magician's last trick filled the audience with amazement.
items.sentenceZh: 魔術師最後的戲法讓觀眾驚奇不已。

items.audioEn: My clumsy brother dropped the cake on the way to the party.
items.audioZh: 我那笨手笨腳的兄弟在去派對的路上把蛋糕摔了。
items.questionZh: 去派對的路上發生了什麼事？
options: My brother bought a cake for the party
The party was moved to another day
The cake fell to the ground

items.sentenceEn: The dog barked furiously at the delivery truck.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻狗對著送貨卡車狂吠。

items.sentenceEn: The traffic on my way to work this morning was dreadful.
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上我上班路上的交通糟透了。

items.stemEn: Going up the mountain in such weather would be ____.
items.stemZh: 在這種天氣上山是很愚蠢的。

items.stemEn: The comedian never tries to ____ people in the audience by making jokes about their looks.
items.stemZh: 那位喜劇演員從不拿觀眾的外表開玩笑，讓他們難堪。

items.passageEn: Last winter, I tried skiing for the first time. Out of vanity, I bought an expensive red outfit, thinking I would look like a professional. I had underestimated how hard skiing would be. I was so clumsy that I fell over every few meters, and I watched in amazement as small children skied past me. One child laughed at me, which humiliated me a little. On the second day, the weather was dreadful: snow fell furiously, and we could hardly see, so we all stayed inside. On the last day, I practiced with new vigor and finally reached the bottom of the hill without falling.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我第一次去滑雪。出於虛榮心，我買了一套昂貴的紅色滑雪裝，以為自己會看起來像專業選手。我低估了滑雪的難度。我笨手笨腳的，每滑幾公尺就跌倒，還驚訝地看著小小孩從我身邊滑過去。有個小孩笑我，讓我覺得有點丟臉。第二天天氣糟透了：雪下得很猛，大家幾乎什麼都看不見，所以全都待在屋裡。最後一天，我重新打起精神練習，終於一路滑到坡底都沒有跌倒。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼買了昂貴的紅色滑雪裝？
options: 教練規定一定要穿紅色
店裡只剩下那一件的尺寸
那是朋友送的生日禮物

questions.questionZh: 第二天大家為什麼待在屋裡？
options: 雪下得很大，幾乎看不見

items.promptZh: 他氣沖沖地把身後的門關上。
referenceEn: He furiously shut the door behind him.
He shut the door behind him furiously.
rubricZh: furiously 的用法，例如 furiously shut、shut the door furiously 等
時態合理（例如 shut 等）

items.promptZh: 我剛開始學打字的時候，手指很不靈活。
referenceEn: When I first learned to type, my fingers were clumsy.
My fingers felt clumsy when I first started learning to type.
rubricZh: clumsy 表示「笨拙的、不靈活的」（例如 were clumsy、felt clumsy 等）
「剛開始學打字」可寫，例如 when I first learned to type、when I started learning to type 等
